svg.text: One Sunday run → live YouTube data → code measures and groups it → AI writes the brief → saved and emailed → Ishaan films the right video
06:00 UTC health check keeps the free database awake (it sleeps after 7 idle days)
filters · sort · jump to a theme
proves itself with a secret key
reads his niche and today's cache
the settings page reads it back
same day + same niche = no refetch
last good copy if a run fails
How to read it: follow the numbers 1 to 15 left to right. The circled A is the optional manual button; dashed arrows show what gets passed on.
Stack: Next.js on Vercel · Supabase (Postgres) · Gemini Flash + embeddings · YouTube Data API · Resend · Vercel Cron · all free tiers
Safety net: every input and AI answer is checked (Zod) · last good brief if a run fails · 230 automated tests · CI on every push · 66-point live smoke test
